title.narrative: Increasing food security of vulnerable households

description.narrative: The project aims at increasing food security and climate resilience of vulnerable households and promoting gender equity in Mali, Niger, Kenya and Somalia. The target group of the project is small-scale farmers, pastoralists and agro pastoralists and vulnerable groups, such as women-led households, Internally Displaced People (IDP) and people living with disabilities. A mix of interventions will lead to a) an improved availability of healthy and sustainably produced agricultural and livestock products at household level through interventions boosting climate resilient agricultural production, b) improve accessibility to food by strengthening climate resilient livelihoods and increasing incomes of vulnerable households through diversifying income opportunities, c) improve utilization of food by capacity building measures specifically aimed at children and lactating women, d) promote gender equity by strengthening participation of women in decision-making.
